scenes.title: Two Teachers
scenes.speaker: maya
scenes.narration: Welcome. Today two teachers walk you through the whole idea, one step at a time, so nothing gets left behind.

scenes.title: The Big Number
scenes.narration: First, the scale of it. Four numbers tell the whole story before we say another word about the method.

blocks.heading: By the numbers
blocks.note: Every one of these numbers has a story behind it.

scenes.title: How It Flows
scenes.narration: The method is a pipeline. Notes go in, a model writes the words, a voice speaks them, and a renderer draws the frames. Each stage hands its work to the next.

scenes.title: A Warning
scenes.narration: One warning before we go further. The model is only as good as the notes you give it, and a vague brief produces a vague script every time.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A vague brief produces a vague script. Give the model the real details.

scenes.title: The Timeline
scenes.narration: How did we get here? The road runs from typed commands, to scripts, to a model that writes the script, and finally to a machine that draws it.

scenes.title: The Comparison
scenes.narration: So what actually changed? Compare the old way with the new one. The old way is slow and steady; the new way is fast, but it still needs your judgment at the end.

scenes.title: One Quote
scenes.speaker: theo
scenes.narration: A colleague put it well. The point of a tool like this is not to replace the teacher. It is to give the teacher a free afternoon.

blocks.text: It is not here to replace the teacher. It is here to give the teacher a free afternoon.

scenes.title: The Key Points
scenes.narration: If you remember nothing else, remember these. Write a clear brief. Check the draft. Pick a voice that suits the room. Then let the machine draw the frames.

scenes.title: Goodbye
scenes.narration: That is the whole pipeline, end to end. Bring your own notes and try it yourself, and remember that the last step was always yours.
